ETH | Ethereum’s official website updates institutional tokenization data | Network usage does not mean an immediate rise in the token price
My view is positive on the long-term use cases for infrastructure, but for now I’m waiting for confirmation from both capital flows and price action before trading. Ethereum’s official institutional tokenization page is marked as updated on October 15. It lists about $146.4 billion in stablecoins on Ethereum mainnet and about $16.56 billion on layer 2, and notes that institutions can issue assets, make programmable settlements, and process payments on Ethereum and its layer 2 networks. This is network usage data presented by the official website—not a newly approved ETF today, nor evidence that institutions have just bought an equivalent amount of ETH. Binance Square’s trending topics at this moment have no ETH story directly related to this information, so I won’t attach unrelated labels to ETH based on a BTC rebound or buzz around other coins.

Why is this data worth watching? Stablecoins and tokenized assets create real demand for network settlement: transfers, trading, custody, and contract execution all depend on reliable transaction infrastructure. Ethereum mainnet handles high-value settlement and security, while layer 2 networks support lower-cost activity. This can strengthen ecosystem stickiness, but it does not automatically mean that all on-chain asset value translates into ETH purchases. Stablecoin market capitalization represents the value of tokens corresponding to outstanding liabilities or reserves; it is not net buying of ETH. There are also several layers of mechanisms between layer 2 fees, mainnet data fees, burning, and staking yields. To judge whether ETH is benefiting, I’ll look at actual transaction volume, fees, ETH supply and demand, and fund holdings—not just one large figure showing assets already on the network.

Looking at fund flows as a cross-check, Farside’s fund-by-fund table shows combined net outflows of about $60.3 million from US spot ETH ETFs on October 15. The individual products had not yet reported for October 16, so the 0.0 displayed automatically on the page should not be interpreted as a confirmed zero flow for that day. This is a reminder that network usage and secondary-market buying can diverge in the short term. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,461, with a rolling 24-hour low of $2,321 and a high of $2,491. It has rebounded from the low but has not broken above the top of the range. This rebound cannot simply be attributed to the official website update, and it certainly doesn’t prove that ETF flows have shifted to sustained inflows.

My trading framework has two parts. On fundamentals, if more real-world assets and payment activity move onto mainnet and layer 2 networks, the value capture of settlement networks is worth monitoring over time. Risks include competition from other chains, fee diversion to layer 2, regulatory constraints, asset custody, and cross-chain security. In the short term, around $2,490 is a clear level to watch for confirmation from above. If price spikes and then falls back below it, that would suggest buying support is still insufficient. On the downside, I’m watching around $2,420; if that level breaks and a rebound fails to reclaim it, the current recovery thesis is invalidated. If Ethereum revises its statistical methodology, or if sustained ETF outflows coincide with weak on-chain fees, I’ll lower my assessment that growing usage is creating demand for ETH.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t chase a big number, and I wouldn’t use high leverage; I’d only consider a small spot position. If ETH breaks and holds above $2,491, then retests and holds that level with active trading, I’d open a small long position using 2% of my total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,550, then gradually close the rest at the second target of $2,620. I’d set the initial stop-loss at $2,440. If price breaks above $2,491 but then falls back below it and fails to reclaim it within an hour, I’d exit immediately. If price first breaks below $2,420, I’d cancel the long plan and stay flat while waiting for a new setup. I would never record a plan that was not triggered as a completed trade or profit.

Sources: Ethereum’s official institutional tokenization page, Farside’s ETH fund-by-fund table, Kraken spot market. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH｜以太坊官网更新机构代币化数据｜网络使用不等于币价立刻上涨
我的态度是看好基础设施的长期使用场景，但当前交易仍等待资金与价格双重确认。以太坊官网机构代币化页面标注10月15日更新，列出以太坊主网稳定币规模约1464亿美元、二层约165.6亿美元，并说明机构可在以太坊及其二层上进行资产发行、可编程结算与支付。这是官网展示的网络使用资料，不是今天新批准的ETF、也不是机构刚刚买入同等金额ETH。币安广场热榜此刻没有与该事实直接匹配的ETH话题，我不借BTC反弹或其他币热点给ETH贴无关标签。

为什么这组数据值得看？稳定币和代币化资产让网络形成真实结算需求：转账、交易、托管和合约执行都依赖可靠的交易基础设施。以太坊主网负责高价值结算与安全，二层承接更低成本的活动；这能提升生态黏性，却不会自动把所有链上资产规模换算为ETH购买。稳定币市值是流通负债或储备对应的代币规模，不是ETH净买盘；二层费用、主网数据费用、销毁与质押收益之间还隔着多层机制。要判断ETH是否受益，我会看实际交易量、费用、ETH供需与资金持仓，而不是只看一个庞大的存量数字。

交叉看资金端，Farside逐只基金表中10月15日美国ETH现货ETF合计约净流出6030万美元，10月16日各产品尚未填报，页面自动显示的0.0不能解读为当日确认零流量。这提醒我：网络使用规模与二级市场买盘可能短期背离。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2461美元，滚动24小时最低2321、最高2491美元，已从低位反弹但未越过区间上沿。这个反弹不能简单归功于官网页面更新，更不能由此断言ETF资金转为持续流入。

我的交易框架分两层：基本面上，若未来更多真实资产与支付活动落在主网和二层，结算网络的价值捕获值得持续跟踪；风险在于不同链竞争、二层费用分流、合规约束、资产托管和跨链安全。短线方面，2490附近是明确的上方验证位，若冲高后跌回，说明买盘承接仍不足；下方看2420附近，失守且反抽不过，则本轮修复假设失效。若官网统计口径修订，或后续ETF连续流出同时链上费用疲软，我会下调“使用增长带来ETH需求”的判断。

如果是我自己交易：目前不因大数字追多，不参与高杠杆；只考虑现货试仓。若ETH有效站上2491美元、回踩守住且成交活跃，用总资金2%试多；首个目标2550美元先减半，第二目标2620美元逐步平仓。初始止损放在2440美元，突破后重新跌回2491且一小时不能收复，也直接退出。若价格先跌破2420，取消多头计划并空仓等新结构，绝不把未触发计划记成成交或盈利。

Held for 9 years, XRP holders are still 62% underwater, while BTC has tripled—who's lying? 📉

Let’s start with three numbers.
$XRP  is now $1.33, 62.5% below its January 2018 peak of $3.55. Same peak, same investor—bought nearly 9 years ago, and still underwater.
Over the same period, $BTC  is up 314% from its December 2017 peak; $ETH  is up 66%; BNB is up about 2,800%, and DOGE is up 322%. Same market, same stretch of time—the difference comes down to what you bought.
Look closer, and XRP’s underperformance isn’t surprising. Its circulating supply has grown over the years, inflows are weak, and on-chain activity and trading volume are both declining. Its payments narrative is too narrow, and after years tied up in lawsuits, institutions would rather put their money into ETFs than give it a second look.
The takeaway is simple: HODL isn’t a cure-all. The market only rewards assets whose fundamentals keep pace. Holding for a long time is a secondary condition; holding the right asset is what makes the difference.
So the key question isn’t “Can I buy the dip after a 62% drop?” but “What reason is there to believe it can recover?” The path back depends on capital, not sentiment.
If you still hold XRP, how patient are you feeling these days?

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s a Ticket to the Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to pull the trigger on a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
can’t take it. Look at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more often right, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know that whether
this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates when it’s time to stop out, tell yourself: This is an admission ticket, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

The crypto market is a battlefield that never sleeps. Some people get rich overnight, while others lose everything in an instant. #ETH 

But what truly determines your fate isn’t market volatility—it’s the stage you’re at.

I went from 2 million to 60 million, and these are the 4 stages I’ve come to understand
1. Beginner stage: staying up all night watching charts, heart racing
When I first got started, every price swing got under my skin. I bought and it fell; I sold and it rose. I’d wake up in the middle of the night just to check the market on my phone. What I feared most were sudden crashes in the early hours. I’d agonize over whether to “cut my losses or hold on,” only to wake up and find I’d been wiped out just before the dawn.
The truth: 90% of beginners get taken out by their own emotions.

2. Intermediate stage: learning to wait and act at the right moment
After taking a few losses, I finally understood: not every price swing is worth chasing. I started paying attention to the bigger trends, such as Federal Reserve policy and Bitcoin halvings, though I’d still stay up all night for major market moves.
The breakthrough: going from “trading constantly” to “striking with precision” is the first step toward making a profit.

3. Expert stage: sleeping soundly while your system makes money
Experienced traders have already built a trading system and set stop-loss and take-profit levels. They don’t need to watch the charts to make money. Even if the market plunges 20% in the middle of the night, they can sleep peacefully because everything is going according to plan.
The key: trading isn’t about stamina—it’s about strategy.

4. Despair stage: trapped in losing positions, liquidated, sleepless and depressed
Getting liquidated with high leverage, watching altcoins go to zero… Lying in bed scrolling through Twitter, hoping to find a “chance to turn things around,” only to sink deeper and deeper.
A warning: If you’re at this stage right now, stop. There may still be a way out.

币圈是个不分黑夜的战场，有人一夜暴富，有人瞬间归零#ETH 

但真正决定命运的，不是行情波动，而是你处在哪个阶段

我从200万到6000万，我悟透了这4个阶段
1. 新手期：熬夜盯盘，心跳加速
刚入场时，每个波动都牵动神经。买了就跌，卖了就涨，半夜惊醒也要摸手机看行情。最怕凌晨的闪崩，纠结“割肉还是硬扛”，结果一觉醒来，发现自己倒在黎明前
真相：90%的新手都倒在了情绪失控上

2. 进阶期：学会等待，关键出手
吃过几次亏后，终于明白：不是每个波动都值得追。开始关注大趋势，比如美联储政策、比特币减半，但依然会为关键行情熬夜

3. 高手期：淡定睡觉，系统赚钱
老手早已建立交易系统，设好止损止盈，不靠盯盘赚钱。哪怕半夜暴跌20%，也能安心睡觉，因为一切都在计划内
核心：交易不是拼体力，而是拼策略

4. 绝望期：深套爆仓，失眠抑郁
高杠杆爆仓、山寨币归零……躺在床上刷推特，幻想找到“翻身机会”，却越陷越深

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where to place a stop-loss takes more thought than whether to set one. Too close, and you get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
looking to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other people’s stop-loss orders.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the structure fails: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Bullish and bearish sentiment is hidden in funding rates: learn to read three typical states
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we discussed how funding rates work. Today, let’s look at how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

[State 1: Funding rates stay high and positive] This means longs are crowded, and everyone is borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often in the final stages of a rapid run-up, and a sharp drop from a “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. This doesn’t mean you should immediately
shorting, but rather: be extra cautious when chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past started at moments like this.

【History doesn’t repeat itself, but it often rhymes—and that’s where the gold is】

Back in 2019, ETH crashed from $1,400 to $80, a drop of nearly 95%. People were saying all sorts of things—“ETH is dead,” “Ethereum is going to zero.” And then? Compound kicked off liquidity mining, igniting DeFi Summer, and ETH climbed nearly 20x from the bottom.

Now I’m seeing a similar scene unfold again. ETH is down more than 50% from its high, once again standing at a historic crossroads.

What’s interesting is that this time, it’s not DeFi—it’s AI.

A couple of days ago, I saw a news story about an OpenAI agent going to the Sepolia testnet and taking ETH, with people saying that “the funds were effectively abandoned.” The tech world erupted—some criticized it, others defended it—but no one seemed to notice what really mattered: AI applications are starting to settle transactions in ETH.

What does that mean?

As AI agents start collaborating, paying for services, and holding assets, ETH could become their default settlement layer. Gas fees, staking, cross-chain transactions—things that used to matter only to crypto traders—suddenly have real-world use cases.

Of course, don’t get ahead of yourself in the short term. ETH is still fluctuating between 2345 and 2538, and it’s down 1.5% over the past 24 hours. This kind of choppy market is exhausting, but historical data tells us that when an asset is more than 50% below its ATH, that range is often where long-term investors start building positions.

How can we tell whether this narrative is real? Don’t listen to the hype—look at the actual data: how much ETH gas is genuinely being consumed by AI applications, and how many AI projects are actually deploying on Ethereum. Those numbers don’t lie.

Can this ETH narrative last? I’m inclined to think it can, but only if the convergence of AI and crypto becomes real—not just a concept dressed up in marketing.

What do you think—is AI agents using ETH a genuine trend, or just the tech world getting carried away with itself?

📰 Just said Solana needed to speed things up, and now it’s suddenly upgrading: What exactly is Alpenglow supposed to do?

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s an update. Solana has announced an upgrade called Alpenglow, aimed at making transactions faster. That sounds pretty straightforward, but this upgrade could be more complex than we first thought. It’s not just about speed—it could also affect Solana’s overall market position and how worthwhile it is to use.

💡 Why is this upgrade important? Why is Solana suddenly rolling out Alpenglow? Simply put, competition in the industry is fierce. ETH and Solana are both vying to be the “highway” of Web3, but ETH has recently been losing some users due to various issues. Solana needs to roll out new features quickly to keep users around. Alpenglow could not only boost speed, but also make smart contracts more energy-efficient and cheaper to run. That means building a Dapp on Solana could cost significantly less and be a better experience. For Solana, it’s like upgrading its highway with faster toll booths and a more fuel-efficient engine.

What could this mean for the market? In theory, it should be bullish. ETH is still struggling around $2.4K. If this Solana upgrade can significantly cut costs and improve efficiency, it could attract more developers and users, and even take some market share away from ETH. That said, the blockchain world is highly unpredictable. Whether the upgrade launches on schedule, how well it works, and the intensity of market competition could all diminish its potential benefits. It’s a bit like Ethereum’s EIP-4844 (Proto-Danksharding) upgrade last year: it was theoretically bullish, but the real-world impact took a while to materialize. Whether Solana can deliver faster than ETH is a key question.

As we mentioned a couple of days ago, if the Alpenglow upgrade ultimately fails or users simply aren’t interested, this potential positive could quickly turn into a negative. The entire crypto market is also waiting on regulatory news, and if regulations suddenly tighten, all cryptocurrencies will come under pressure. So this isn’t a guaranteed positive—it all depends on what happens next.

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。Solana宣布要搞个叫Alpenglow的升级，目标是让交易更快。听起来很正常，但这次升级可能比之前想的更复杂，因为它不光是速度，还可能影响Solana的整个市场地位和用起来到底值不值。

💡 这次升级重要在哪？为什么Solana突然要搞这个Alpenglow？简单说：行业竞争太激烈了。ETH和Solana都是想当Web3的"高速公路"，但ETH最近因为各种问题用户有点流失，Solana得赶紧用新功能把用户留住。Alpenglow不光提速，还可能让智能合约运行更省电、更便宜。这意味着用Solana做个Dapp，成本会大幅降低，用起来更爽。对Solana来说，这就像给自家高速公路修了个更快的收费站+更省油的引擎。

对市场的影响？理论上应该是利多的。ETH现在还在$2.4K附近挣扎，如果Solana这次升级真的能显著降低成本、提升效率，可能会吸引更多开发者和用户，甚至可能抢走ETH的一些市场份额。但话说回来，区块链世界变数太大，这个升级能不能如期落地、效果好不好，还有市场竞争的激烈程度，都可能让这个利好打折扣。就像去年Ethereum改进提案EIP-4844（Proto-Danksharding）一样，理论上利好但实际效果慢了点。Solana这次能不能比ETH更快落地，是个关键点。

前两天刚提过，如果Alpenglow升级最终失败，或者用户根本不买账，这个利好立马就成利空了。而且现在整个加密市场都在等监管消息，如果监管突然收紧，所有加密货币都得承压。所以这个利好不是绝对的，要看后续怎么走。

title: 2016年，以太坊一分为二：ETH赢了市场，ETC输了什么？
subTitle:
一个被币圈忽略了10年的问题：如果2016年以太坊没有硬分叉，今天的ETC会不会就是ETH？

我一直觉得，整个加密货币历史上，有一件事被严重低估了。

那就是2016年以太坊和以太经典的分裂。

今天提起ETH，大家想到的是智能合约、DeFi、稳定币、Layer 2，以及庞大的区块链生态。

提起ETC，很多人可能只记得它是以太坊的分叉币。

甚至有人觉得，ETC就是一个早已被市场淘汰的老项目。

但如果我告诉你：

今天的ETC，才是2016年那条没有接受The DAO硬分叉修改的原始以太坊链呢？

更值得思考的是：

如果当年没有发生那次分叉，今天我们熟悉的ETH，会不会就是那条原始链发展出来的结果？

这个问题，值得所有持有ETH和ETC的人认真思考。

一、2016年，一场价值数千万美元的攻击，改变了以太坊的命运

2016年，以太坊生态诞生了一个名叫The DAO的项目。

它试图利用智能合约建立一种去中心化投资组织。

这个项目当时募集了约1270万枚ETH，价值约1.5亿美元。

在那个加密货币市场规模还很小的年代，这是一笔极其惊人的资金。

但2016年6月17日，意外发生了。

攻击者利用The DAO智能合约中的重入漏洞，转移了约360万枚ETH。

按当时价格计算，涉及资金约数千万美元。

整个以太坊社区陷入恐慌。

当时摆在所有人面前的，是一道几乎没有完美答案的选择题。

A：通过硬分叉修改相关资金状态，帮助受影响的投资者追回资金。

B：坚持区块链不可篡改的原则，即使发生重大损失，也不进行这种特殊干预。

支持A的人认为，如果不采取措施，以太坊可能遭遇严重的信任危机。

支持B的人则认为，如果区块链可以因为损失巨大就改变规则，那么所谓的不可篡改究竟还有什么意义？

双方都有自己的理由。

最终，2016年7月20日，以太坊在区块高度1,920,000实施硬分叉。

接受特殊状态修改的链继续使用ETH名称。

拒绝这次修改的链继续运行，后来被称为Ethereum Classic，也就是ETC。

从此，曾经属于同一个网络的两条链，开始了完全不同的命运。

二、一个非常反常识的事实：ETC并不是后来凭空创造出来的

很多人以为ETH是原版，ETC是后来复制出来的。

这种理解并不准确。

2016年硬分叉发生之前，两条链共享同一段区块链历史。

分叉之后，ETH沿着修改过资金状态的新规则继续运行。

ETC则保留了未接受该次修改的历史状态。

也就是说，从2016年The DAO事件的角度看，ETC延续的是没有进行那次特殊状态干预的链。

当然，这并不代表ETC后来从未升级，也不代表它的所有代码都停留在2016年。

两条链此后都经历了独立发展。

但真正让我感兴趣的，不是谁更有资格自称原版。

而是另外一个问题：

既然双方拥有共同的技术起点，为什么十年之后，命运会出现如此巨大的差距？

三、ETC输掉的，可能根本不是技术

我认为，2016年真正决定两条链未来的，不只是硬分叉本身。

而是硬分叉之后，开发者、资本、交易所和整个生态的选择。

2016年7月26日，以太坊基金会明确表示，将把资源和注意力集中在硬分叉后的ETH链上。

这意味着什么？

意味着ETH不仅继承了以太坊这个名字，还获得了核心开发力量的持续支持。

随后，越来越多的开发者选择ETH。

越来越多的应用部署在ETH。

越来越多的资金进入ETH生态。

ICO、DeFi、NFT、稳定币、Layer 2……

这些领域的发展，让ETH逐渐建立起强大的网络效应。

反观ETC。

虽然它保留了原有链的历史，却没有获得同等规模的开发者、资本和应用支持。

这就是区块链世界非常残酷的一面。

你可以继承一条区块链的历史，却未必能够继承它未来的繁荣。

代码可以复制。

技术可以学习。

甚至很多协议都可以直接开源。

但用户、流动性、开发者和市场共识，不是复制几行代码就能得到的。

四、假如当年没有硬分叉，ETC会不会成为今天的ETH？

我认为，这种可能性非常值得讨论。

假设2016年，以太坊社区最终决定不实施The DAO硬分叉。

那么原来的链就会继续运行。

Vitalik Buterin可能继续领导技术研究。

以太坊基金会可能继续支持原有网络。

开发者也可能继续围绕同一条链建设。

后来出现的DeFi、稳定币、NFT和Layer 2生态，完全有可能在这条没有分裂的网络上发展起来。

甚至从PoW转向PoS，也不是不可能。

因为是否接受2016年The DAO资金状态修改，与未来是否升级共识机制，本来就是两个不同的问题。

但这里存在一个不能忽视的变量。

如果当年没有采取干预措施，The DAO事件造成的损失可能严重打击投资者信心。

社区内部也可能因为这场危机出现其他形式的分裂。

所以，没有人能够证明，不分叉的以太坊一定会发展得更好。

但同样没有人能够证明，不分叉就一定会失败。

今天ETC的弱势，不能用来直接证明2016年坚持不分叉是错误的。

这是我认为很多人讨论ETH和ETC时，最容易忽略的逻辑问题。

五、ETC坚持的原则，真的错了吗？

我不认为。

ETC最重要的历史叙事，就是坚持区块链不可篡改的理念。

这个理念听起来很简单。

但如果认真思考，就会发现它涉及区块链最根本的权力问题。

假设某一天，一个大型机构因为智能合约漏洞损失了100亿美元。

它要求社区通过硬分叉追回资产。

你支持吗？

如果受损的是普通散户呢？

如果损失的是某个国家的公共基金呢？

如果遭遇攻击的是整个区块链生态中最重要的应用呢？

到底损失达到多少，才有资格要求修改规则？

谁来决定？

基金会？

开发者？

验证者？

矿工？

还是持币数量最多的那批人？

这些问题，没有想象中那么容易回答。

如果规则可以因为某些人的损失而改变，那么谁又能保证，下一次被改变的规则不会伤害其他人？

这正是ETC所坚持的理念具有讨论价值的原因。

但我也必须承认，ETC并不完美。

2020年，ETC曾遭遇多次严重的51%攻击和链重组事件。

这暴露了PoW网络在算力安全不足时面临的风险。

区块链的不可篡改，不仅需要理念，也需要足够强大的经济安全保障。

否则，即使规则设计得再漂亮，也可能在现实攻击面前付出代价。

六、ETC有固定供应量，为什么仍然没能超越ETH？

还有一个问题值得讨论。

ETC采用PoW共识机制。

根据后来实施的货币政策，它每500万个区块将区块奖励减少20%，长期最大供应量约为2.107亿枚。

ETH则在2022年完成The Merge，转向PoS共识机制。

ETH没有固定的最大供应量，通过质押发行和手续费销毁共同影响净供应。

如果只看供应规则，ETC似乎更接近比特币强调的可预测发行模式。

但市场没有因此让ETC获得比ETH更高的估值。

为什么？

因为稀缺性本身并不等于价值。

假设我发行一种数字货币，总量只有1000枚。

它就一定比总量1亿枚的数字货币更值钱吗？

显然不是。

市场真正关心的，是资产背后有没有持续的需求。

有没有人使用？

有没有开发者建设？

有没有真实的经济活动？

有没有足够的资金愿意长期持有？

ETH在这些方面建立了明显优势。

当然，ETH生态的繁荣也不意味着所有经济价值都一定能转化为ETH代币的价格上涨。

这仍然需要观察网络费用、质押需求、资产使用场景，以及Layer 2对主网的价值反馈。

但从长期基本面来看，ETH拥有的生态优势，确实比ETC更加明确。

七、如果今天让我在ETH和ETC之间选择

我的答案是ETH。

但并不是因为我认为ETC的理念毫无价值。

恰恰相反。

我认为ETC的历史地位被很多人低估了。

它让整个加密货币行业看到了一个事实：

即使主流开发力量选择了另一条链，只要仍然有人愿意维护原有规则，一条区块链就可能继续运行。

这是去中心化精神的一种体现。

但投资终究要面对现实。

ETC需要的不只是历史故事。

它还需要更多开发者、更多真实应用、更活跃的链上经济，以及足够强大的网络安全保障。

否则，再有吸引力的历史叙事，也可能长期停留在叙事阶段。

而ETH同样不能高枕无忧。

今天拥有庞大的生态，不代表未来一定能够永远领先。

区块链行业的竞争还远远没有结束。

八、十年过去，我反而越来越理解ETC存在的意义

2016年，ETH和ETC因为一次重大争议分道扬镳。

十年之后，ETH成为智能合约领域的重要基础设施。

ETC则继续作为一条独立的PoW公链存在。

从投资回报、生态规模和市场影响力来看，两条链的发展结果已经非常不同。

但我不认为这段历史只能用赢家和输家来解释。

ETH代表了一种选择：

在重大危机面前，社区可以通过集体协调改变协议规则，并继续推动网络发展。

ETC代表了另一种选择：

即使付出巨大的生态代价，也要坚持不为特定事件修改既定交易结果的原则。

两种选择背后，都有值得认真讨论的逻辑。

我甚至觉得，2016年那次硬分叉留给整个币圈的最大遗产，不是ETH，也不是ETC。

而是一个直到今天仍然没有标准答案的问题：

当区块链的不可篡改原则，与巨大的现实利益发生冲突时，我们究竟应该坚持规则，还是修改规则？

如果未来某一天，比特币也遭遇类似的重大危机呢？

假设数百万枚BTC因为某种重大安全漏洞被盗。

整个社区同样分裂成两个阵营。

一方要求通过硬分叉追回资产。

另一方坚持不改变原有链上历史。

两条链都继续运行。

那么，究竟哪一条才是真正的比特币？

是保留原始历史的那条？

还是获得更多开发者、矿工、交易所和市场支持的那条？

我不知道到时候市场会如何选择。

但2016年的ETH和ETC，已经给所有人提供了一个值得研究的历史案例。

有时候，一条区块链可以在理念上坚持自己的原则，却在市场竞争中失去优势。

另一条区块链可以在重大争议中改变规则，却最终建立起更庞大的经济生态。

这两件事并不矛盾。

所以，如果有人问我：

假如2016年没有发生硬分叉，今天的ETC会不会就是ETH？

我的回答是：

很有可能。

但在那个假设的世界里，它或许根本不会叫ETC。

它仍然叫以太坊。

而今天我们所熟悉的ETH和ETC之间的争论，也可能从来没有出现过。

历史不能重来。

但真正理解这段历史，或许能让我们对区块链的价值、共识与未来，产生完全不同的认识。

I’d like to share my own choice in the debate over whether Bitcoin or Ethereum is better.

I’ve been a long-term ETH bull for two years. Ever since Bitcoin first crossed $100,000 two years ago, I’ve been more inclined to favor Ethereum.

Over the past two years, I’ve weathered the market’s ups and downs and faced plenty of ridicule and skepticism. But even today, if I had to choose again, I would still choose ETH.

The reason is simple.

Bitcoin made humanity realize the need for crypto assets, while Ethereum changed what’s possible in the crypto ecosystem.

Ethereum goes further. It’s not just an asset, but an open financial infrastructure that can be continuously upgraded. From smart contracts, stablecoins, and DeFi to RWAs and on-chain settlement, it keeps expanding the boundaries of blockchain applications.

Another question worth considering over the long term is how well each community can govern itself in the face of technological change.

Over the past two years, I’ve repeatedly talked about the potential challenges quantum computing poses to Bitcoin. What’s truly worth paying attention to isn’t just whether quantum computing can threaten existing cryptography, but whether the Bitcoin community can reach consensus when the entire network needs a major upgrade. The Ethereum community doesn’t face this problem.

Another point concerns traditional financial markets. If AI disrupts employment, institutions will fall into disarray. We have at most two years before the whole world enters a prolonged and complex period of social and institutional turmoil.

Traditional financial markets are very likely to face a prolonged period of turbulence, and it will take a long time to adapt to an AI-driven society.

Although Trump has used hardline measures since taking office to stimulate investment and economic growth, he’s ultimately spending tomorrow’s money. And after AI disrupts industries across the board, nobody knows what that world will look like. We can only wait for the sky to fall, have the tallest people hold it up, and gradually improve the system.

You could think of it as a massive bug in global social governance that needs fixing. While it’s being fixed, no one will care how many points the Nasdaq is at.

关于比特币和以太坊谁更优质，我想聊聊自己的选择。

我是一个两年的 ETH 多头。从两年前，比特币第一次站上 10 万美元开始，我就更倾向于以太坊。

这两年经历过市场的起起伏伏，也挨过不少嘲讽和质疑，但直到今天，如果让我重新选择一次，我依然会选择 ETH。

原因很简单。

比特币让人类认识到加密资产的必要性，而以太坊改变了加密生态的可能性。

以太坊走得更远。它不仅是一种资产，更是一个可以持续升级的开放式金融基础设施。从智能合约、稳定币、DeFi，到 RWA 和链上结算，它不断拓展着区块链的应用边界。

过去两年，我反复讲量子计算给比特币带来的潜在挑战。真正值得关注的，不只是量子计算能否威胁现有密码学，更是当整个网络必须进行重大升级时，比特币社区能否形成共识，以太坊社区没有这种问题。

I’m managing ETH risk first | U.S. tech stocks under pressure | Correlation is not proof that ETH must fall

I’m cautious on ETH in the short term, but I won’t mechanically treat Ethereum as just another stock because U.S. AI and semiconductor stocks have fallen. Binance Square is discussing “AI and semiconductor stocks losing over $1 trillion in market cap this week”; that total depends on which companies and dates are selected. I haven’t obtained a primary constituent list that I can independently recalculate, so I’m treating it only as a topic title, not a verified statistic. What can be directly checked is the NYSE trading desk’s morning report for October 16: the S&P 500 closed up about 0.3% in the previous session, while the tech sector remained under pressure and AI-related stocks underperformed. Longer-term Treasury yields fell, while some data-center stocks also declined in premarket trading. The broad market rose as the tech sector weakened—a reminder not to sum up the risk with “the whole market is crashing.”

The impact on ETH is not one-directional. If a tech-stock pullback leads investors to reduce exposure to volatile assets, both spot ETH and leveraged positions could come under pressure. But if long-term yields fall and liquidity expectations improve, risk assets could also rebound. Ethereum network activity, gas usage, and institutional-product flows are variables distinct from U.S. tech valuations. Farside’s fund-by-fund table shows combined net outflows of about $60.3 million from U.S. ETH funds on October 15; the figures for each product on October 16 are still blank dashes, so the automatically calculated total of 0.0 cannot be described as “zero outflows today.” I won’t directly attribute a short-term market decline to a single stock-market topic, nor dress up ETF data that hasn’t been updated as new buying.

The market has already given us price signals that deserve respect. As I write, ETH/USD on Kraken is around $2,408, below the daily open of $2,439; the rolling 24-hour low is $2,390 and the high is $2,491. BTC is around $81,500 over the same period, also below its daily open of $82,135, though the two assets’ declines and timing are not identical. If ETH can’t reclaim $2,435–$2,450, I think a short-term recovery remains fragile. Above that, I’m watching the previous-high area around $2,480–$2,490. To the downside, first $2,390, then $2,360. If the price breaks below $2,390 and can’t get back above $2,400 on a rebound, my “recovery within the range” view is invalidated. Conversely, if it holds above $2,490 and spot buying continues, I’ll need to reassess my cautious stance. Stock-market correlations offer a framework for observation; the key is still ETH’s own buying and selling pressure.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t try to catch the bottom now. I’d stay on the sidelines for direction and avoid high leverage. Only if spot ETH moves above $2,450 and holds $2,435 on a retest would I consider a small long position of about 1.5% of my total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,485 and watch $2,530 with the rest. After entry, I’d reduce the position if the price falls back below $2,425, and stop out and close the entire position if it breaks below $2,390. If the price first breaks below $2,390, the original long setup is canceled; I won’t describe passively waiting as a filled trade. What would truly overturn my view isn’t a new buzzword trending, but an improvement in price, flows, and risk appetite together.

The Legend of Shitcoins

At three-thirty in the morning, Chen Hao’s phone screen lit up.

He rubbed his tired eyes and habitually opened Binance for a quick look. TIA was trading at 0.6739 USDT, up 13 percent in 24 hours. He sighed and placed his phone face down on the table.

He hadn’t always been like this.

Three years earlier, Chen Hao had worked in IT operations at an internet company, earning 12,000 yuan a month and working overtime until eleven every night. One day, his colleague Lao Liu told him in the break room that a shitcoin called PEPE had gone up twentyfold in three days. Chen Hao thought the guy was crazy. What could a frog meme possibly be worth?

But Lao Liu showed him a screenshot. An initial investment of 50,000 yuan had become 980,000.

That night, Chen Hao couldn’t sleep.

The next day, he opened a Binance account and transferred 30,000 yuan into it. He didn’t buy PEPE because it had already shot up. Instead, he started searching various chat groups for “the next PEPE.” Someone recommended FLOKI. He bought some, then sold as soon as it was up 30 percent, making 9,000 yuan. He was so happy that he treated the whole team to hot pot.

Later, he bought something called SHIB. This time, he held on—and watched it drop 60 percent. He stubbornly held on for two months, then finally cut his losses when it was down by half. His 30,000 yuan had become 22,000.

Chen Hao couldn’t accept it.

Early in 2024, he saw someone in a Telegram group touting a coin called WIF, claiming it was about to be listed on Binance. It was trading for just 20 cents outside the exchange, and would rise at least tenfold after listing. Chen Hao went all in with the 22,000 yuan he had left.

After he bought in, WIF did rise for a while, climbing from 20 cents to 35 cents. Chen Hao thought he’d finally gotten the hang of it. But then came a huge red candle, crashing the price straight back down to 12 cents. The “expert” in the group disappeared, and the group was disbanded.

His 22,000 yuan was down to 13,000.

Chen Hao gave up trying to make a quick buck. He used the remaining 13,000 yuan to buy some ETH, set up a recurring purchase, then moved the Binance app from his home screen to a folder on the second page. He stopped checking group chats and scrolling through Twitter. He went to work and came home on time every day, and went running on weekends.

And so two years went by.

Then, in the early hours of this morning, on a whim, he opened Binance again. The price of ETH left him staring at the screen for a full ten seconds. He opened his spot account. The recurring purchases he’d forgotten about had quietly accumulated a sizable amount of ETH over two years. With the rise in the coin’s price, the balance displayed in his account was so high he thought his eyes were playing tricks on him.

His initial 13,000 yuan had become 470,000.

He didn’t get excited or post a screenshot on social media. He didn’t even tell Lao Liu. He simply closed his phone, lay back in bed, and stared blankly at the shifting early-morning light on the ceiling.

Later, Chen Hao often told his friends: “The hardest part of trading crypto isn’t analyzing candlestick charts or looking at on-chain data. It’s not selling in a panic when prices crash, and not chasing the highs when they soar.”

But more importantly, you have to survive long enough.

土狗币传奇

凌晨三点半，陈浩的手机屏幕亮了一下。

他揉了揉发酸的眼睛，习惯性地打开币安看了一眼。TIA报价0.6739USDT，二十四小时涨了百分之十三。他叹了口气，把手机扣在桌上。

三年前他不是这样的。

那时候陈浩在一家互联网公司做运维，月薪一万二，每天加班到十一点。有一天同事老刘在茶水间跟他说，有个叫PEPE的土狗币三天翻了二十倍。陈浩当时觉得这人疯了，一个青蛙表情包能值什么钱？

但老刘给他看了截图。五万块本金，变成了九十八万。

那天晚上陈浩失眠了。

第二天他开了币安账户，转了三万块进去。他没有买PEPE，因为PEPE已经涨上去了。他开始在各种群里找"下一个PEPE"。有人推荐FLOKI，他买了，涨了百分之三十就跑了，赚了九千块，高兴得请全组吃了顿火锅。

后来他又买了一个叫SHIB的东西，这次没跑，结果跌了百分之六十。他死扛了两个月，最后在腰斩的位置割肉离场。三万变成了两万二。

陈浩不甘心。

二零二四年年初，他在一个Telegram群里看到有人喊单，说一个叫WIF的币要上币安，现在场外价才两毛钱，上了之后至少翻十倍。陈浩把剩下的两万二全梭了。

买入之后，WIF确实涨了一波，从两毛涨到了三毛五。陈浩觉得自己终于开窍了。但紧接着就是一根大阴线，直接砸回一毛二。群里的"老师"消失了，群也解散了。

两万二剩下一万三。

陈浩彻底佛系了。他把剩下的一万三买了点ETH，设了个定投，然后把币安APP从手机主屏幕移到了第二页的文件夹里。他不再看群，不再刷推特，每天按时上班下班，周末去跑步。

日子就这样过了两年。

直到今天凌晨，他鬼使神差地又打开了币安。ETH的价格让他愣了足足十秒钟。他又点开了现货账户，那个被他遗忘的定投，在两年里默默积累了不少ETH，加上币价本身的涨幅，账户余额显示的数字让他以为自己看花了眼。

一万三的本金，变成了四十七万。

他没有激动，没有截图发朋友圈，甚至没有告诉老刘。他只是安静地关掉手机，躺回床上，看着天花板上凌晨的光影发呆。

后来陈浩经常跟朋友说一句话：炒币最难的不是分析K线，不是看链上数据，而是在暴跌的时候不割肉，在暴涨的时候不追高。

但更重要的是，你得先活下来。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What is the funding rate? Why do longs have to pay shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange only collects and distributes the money; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

The alliance, called Quantum Alliance, was officially announced in Lisbon. Its nine founding members include Hacken, Keystone, The Vault, Midnight Foundation, Quantus, and INTMAX.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn't happen in an instant; it's a process. Understand how it works, and you'll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required when opening a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it's 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position and lower your leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: When losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They support one another in the basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spill over to your other positions or principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case outcome of “one bad trade”

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

ETH: Watch the Testnet First | Glamsterdam Gets a Hoodi Date | No Mainnet Schedule, So I Won’t Chase

My stance is cautious observation. A testnet timetable should not be presented as a confirmed mainnet upgrade. The Ethereum Foundation’s October 16 announcement confirmed that Glamsterdam is planned to activate on the Hoodi testnet at epoch 132352, slot 4235264, corresponding to October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC, or October 27 at 1:42:48 a.m. Beijing time. At that point, Hoodi’s block gas limit is planned to rise to 200 million. The Foundation stated that a mainnet date has not yet been decided. The official Hoodi configuration PR lists the same epoch and time, confirming the testnet schedule—not that ETH mainnet has already scaled up.

The news matters for assessing technical risks, not for immediately calculating a price rally. Glamsterdam includes in-protocol proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists, and gas repricing. These are intended to improve block production and validation, and to make the cost of state operations better reflect resource usage. A 200 million limit on Hoodi does not mean the mainnet limit will rise right away, much less that transaction fees will fall proportionally. Contracts with hard-coded gas budgets will also need compatibility testing.

I’m paying particular attention to client coordination. The Foundation reminded Hoodi node operators to update their execution and consensus layer clients before activation. The announcement’s client version table is not yet fully populated, so it would be wrong to claim that all nodes are ready. A testnet activation on schedule, stable client updates, and completed regression testing by application teams would provide grounds to discuss a mainnet date; any delay would require reassessing expectations.

The market has given no reason to get ahead of itself. At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $2,398 on Kraken, with a daily open of $2,439, a 24-hour low of $2,390, and a high of $2,491. The pullback cannot be attributed to the announcement. Farside’s table shows about $60.3 million in net outflows from U.S. spot ETH ETFs on October 15. The individual figures for October 16 are still dashes; an automatically calculated total of 0.0 does not confirm zero flows. Technical progress and investment flows are not yet moving in the same direction.

Key levels to watch are $2,390, $2,439, and $2,490. $2,390 is the 24-hour low; if it breaks, the next level to watch is around $2,350. $2,439 is the daily open and the dividing line between strength and weakness. $2,490 is resistance near the high. I’d only consider a small long position if ETH holds above $2,439 and Hoodi’s preparations encounter no new issues. If ETH falls below $2,390 or officials announce a delay, I’d become more cautious. In the medium term, a formal mainnet schedule and real-world adoption are still needed—not just a testnet date.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t enter right now. I’d only consider a small spot long, with no more than 4% of my total capital committed to a single trade and no high leverage. The entry trigger would be a four-hour close above $2,440, followed by a retest that holds between $2,430 and $2,440, alongside a check on Hoodi’s progress. The first target is $2,490, where I’d take half off; the second is $2,550, where I’d close the rest in stages. The stop loss is below $2,380. If ETH closes below $2,430 for several consecutive periods, I’d exit early. If it first breaks below $2,390, I’d cancel the long and not average down. This is a plan with conditions that have not been met, not a record of a trade.

Sources: the Ethereum Foundation’s October 16 announcement, the official Hoodi configuration repository, Farside’s individual fund table, and live Kraken prices. This article does not force in unrelated trending topics. #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH先看测试网｜Glamsterdam定下Hoodi时间｜主网未排期我不追价

我的态度是谨慎观察，不能把“测试网有时间表”写成“主网升级落地”。以太坊基金会10月16日公告确认：Glamsterdam计划在Hoodi测试网的epoch 132352、slot 4235264激活，对应10月26日17:42:48 UTC，即北京时间10月27日凌晨1:42:48。届时Hoodi的区块Gas上限计划提高到2亿。基金会写明主网时间尚未决定；官方Hoodi配置PR也列出相同epoch与时间，印证的是测试网排期，并非ETH主网已扩容。

消息价值在于验证技术风险，不在于立刻计算币价涨幅。Glamsterdam包含协议内提议者与构建者分离、区块级访问列表及Gas重新计价，旨在改善出块验证，并使状态操作成本更贴近资源消耗。Hoodi上限提到2亿，不等于主网马上提高上限，更不等于交易费按比例下降。写死Gas预算的合约还需测试兼容性。

我特别看客户端协调。基金会提醒Hoodi节点在激活前更新执行层与共识层客户端；公告版本表并未全部填齐，不能宣称“所有节点准备完成”。测试网如期运行、客户端稳定跟进、应用方完成回归测试，才是讨论主网日期的证据；延期则需重估预期。

市场没给出抢跑理由。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2398美元，日开2439，24小时低2390、高2491；不能把回落归因于公告。Farside表中10月15日美国ETH现货ETF净流出约6030万美元，16日分项仍是横杠，自动合计0.0不代表确认零流量。技术进展与配置资金尚未同向。

关键位看2390、2439和2490美元：2390为24小时低位，失守后看2350附近；2439是日开与强弱分界；2490是高位压力。若ETH站稳2439、Hoodi准备无新问题，我才考虑试多。若跌破2390或官方宣布延期，谨慎判断进一步收紧。中期仍需主网正式排期与真实采用，而非一张测试网日期表。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓多单；单次投入不超过总资金的4%，不用高杠杆。入场触发为4小时收盘站上2440美元，回踩2430—2440不破，并核对Hoodi进度。第一目标2490，到位减半；第二目标2550，余仓分批平仓。止损2380下方；若重新连续收在2430下方，提前平仓。若先跌穿2390则取消多单，不补仓摊低成本。这是未触发计划，不是成交记录。

Ethereum Market Depth Analysis: Structural Opportunities and Risk Assessment Amid a Short-Term Pullback

I. Price Trend Review

As of the early hours of October 16, Beijing time, the spot price of Ethereum stood at $2,418, down approximately 0.6% over the past 24 hours. After opening at $2,458, the price continued to decline, reaching an intraday low of $2,393 in the third trading hour before rebounding slightly to around $2,415. Like Bitcoin, Ethereum was affected by higher-than-expected U.S. inflation data. However, due to factors including outflows from Ethereum ETFs and whales depositing assets on exchanges, its overall performance was slightly weaker than Bitcoin’s. Notably, before this decline, Ethereum had touched a recent high of $2,477. Its six-period RSI briefly reached the overbought zone at 79, then quickly fell to an extremely oversold level of 21, making a sharp shift from overbought to oversold.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving average system shows that the current price has fallen below the 7-day moving average at $2,438, the 25-day moving average at $2,447, and the 99-day moving average at $2,460. The three moving averages are in a bearish alignment, and the 99-day moving average is approximately $42 above the price, indicating that medium- and long-term moving averages are exerting clear downward pressure.

Regarding the Bollinger Bands, the price has fallen to near the lower band at $2,414. The middle band is at $2,445, and the upper band is at $2,477, with a bandwidth of approximately $63. Trading close to the lower band usually indicates short-term weakness, but also suggests that demand for a rebound after oversold conditions is building.

The MACD indicator is showing a clear bearish signal: the fast line has fallen to -0.22, the slow line is at 5.80, and the histogram is at -6.02. It has remained negative for four consecutive hours and continues to widen. This indicates that Ethereum’s short-term momentum is shifting increasingly toward the bears. The six-period RSI is 26.45, still in oversold territory; the 12-period RSI is 38.32, and the 24-period RSI is 44.42. The divergence among RSI timeframes indicates heavy short-term selling pressure, although the medium- and long-term trend has not yet turned fully bearish.

For the KDJ indicator, K is 22.60, D is 31.24, and J is 5.33. The J value has begun to recover from negative territory, suggesting that conditions for an oversold rebound are gradually maturing. The Williams indicator improved from -81.66 in the previous hour to -77.79, moving out of oversold territory.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

On the capital-flow front, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded average daily net outflows of $130 million this week. The continued withdrawal of institutional funds is putting direct pressure on prices. Meanwhile, a whale deposited 15,361 ETH into centralized exchanges, adding to potential near-term selling pressure. On the positive side, another large whale exchanged 1,601 BTC for 53,095 ETH. Together with the outflow of 23,528 ETH from institutional custody, this suggests that some large investors are rotating from Bitcoin into Ethereum, and that demand for long-term bullish Ethereum allocations remains.

Fundamentally, a major brokerage has announced that it will offer direct Ethereum trading to 40.1 million retail customers, while the rollout of custody services is also underway. This will significantly broaden institutional access to Ethereum. In the on-chain ecosystem, Ethereum remains a core infrastructure layer for decentralized finance and stablecoins. Positive developments such as Visa’s global rollout of cross-border USDC payments and the upcoming implementation of the GENIUS Act stablecoin framework support Ethereum’s long-term value.

Across the combined signals, nine of 15 quantitative factors are bullish, five are bearish, and one is neutral. The bullish proportion is 60%, and the composite indicator value is 0.9647, producing a bullish signal with a historical win rate of 60%. Although the proportion of bullish signals is lower than for Bitcoin, the higher composite indicator value suggests stronger confidence among the bullish factors at present.

Overall, Ethereum faces the dual short-term pressures of ETF outflows and a technical breakdown, but oversold indicators and expanded institutional access provide a basis for a medium-term rebound. In the short term, watch support at the $2,400 psychological level, with resistance near the 99-day moving average around $2,460.

以太坊市场深度分析：短期回调中的结构性机会与风险评估

一、价格走势回顾

截至北京时间十月十六日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报两千四百一十八美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之零点六。价格从两千四百五十八美元开盘后持续走低，在第三个交易小时跌至两千三百九十三美元的日内低点，随后小幅反弹至两千四百一十五美元附近。与比特币类似，以太坊同样受到了美国通胀数据超预期的冲击，但由于以太坊自身的ETF资金流出和鲸鱼存入交易所等因素，整体表现略弱于比特币。值得注意的是，在本轮下跌之前，以太坊曾触及两千四百七十七美元的近期高点，RSI六周期指标一度达到七十九的超买区域，随后快速回落至二十一点的极度超卖水平，完成了从超买到超卖的剧烈切换。

二、技术指标解读

移动均线系统显示，当前价格已经跌破了七日均线两千四百三十八美元、二十五日均线两千四百四十七美元以及九十九日均线两千四百六十美元，三条均线呈空头排列，且九十九日均线与价格之间的距离约四十二美元，表明中长期均线对价格形成了明显的压制。

布林带方面，价格已经跌至下轨两千四百一十四美元附近，中轨位于两千四百四十五美元，上轨在两千四百七十七美元，带宽约六十三美元。价格贴近下轨运行通常意味着短期处于弱势状态，但也暗示超卖后的反弹需求正在积聚。

MACD指标呈现明显的空头信号，快线跌至负零点二二，慢线为五点八零，柱状图为负六点零二，连续四个小时为负值且持续扩大。这一走势表明以太坊的短期动能正在加速向空方倾斜。RSI六周期指标为二十六点四五，仍处于超卖区域，十二周期RSI为三十八点三二，二十四周期RSI为四十四点四二，不同周期的RSI分化说明短期卖压较重但中长期尚未完全转弱。

KDJ指标中K值为二十二点六零，D值为三十一点二四，J值为五点三三，J值从负值区域开始回升，暗示超卖反弹的条件正在逐步成熟。威廉指标从上小时的负八十一点六六改善至负七十七点七九，正在脱离超卖区域。

三、市场情绪分析

资金面上，美国现货以太坊ETF本周录得一亿三千万美元的日均净流出，机构资金的持续撤退对价格形成了直接压力。与此同时，有鲸鱼将一万五千三百六十一枚以太坊存入了中心化交易所，增加了短期内的潜在抛压。不过从积极的一面来看，另一只大型鲸鱼将一千六百零一枚比特币兑换为五万三千零九十五枚以太坊，配合两万三千五百二十八枚以太坊从机构托管中流出，表明部分大资金正在从比特币向以太坊轮动，长期看多以太坊的配置需求依然存在。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 U control 1,000 U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

[The basics] Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 U of capital and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a position worth 1,000 U. If the price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your capital. Conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your capital—remember, the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to trade.

[The cost] With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by about 10%, your capital is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% can wipe it all out (the precise liquidation point also depends on the margin ratio).

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when you’re right and losing 50% when you’re wrong. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, here’s the long-term math: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
which looks like a positive expectancy. But consider the path: two losses in a row means you’re down 75%, and you need a 300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectancy strategy + going all-in = a high probability of going broke. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

Same strategy, but only use 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row = -18%, hardly a dent,
and you still capture the long-term expected return. The strategy hasn’t changed—only the position size. The difference can be life or death.

A lot of people didn’t understand Warsh’s speech in Bangkok at first.
The market had been on edge. September CPI was clearly still running hot, and everyone expected him to sound hawkish and hint at more rate hikes.
But instead, he refused to prejudge the outcome: he wouldn’t lock in a decision ahead of the policy meeting, said the economy was broadly in line with expectations, and stuck to one point—that inflation needs to be brought under control. He offered no other tough talk.

{web3_wallet_create}(10xcf91b70017eabde82c9671e30e5502d312ea6eb2)

Those few short remarks sent the odds of a rate hike in October tumbling from 27% to below 15%, and the dollar edged lower in response.
Don’t mistake this for a full-blown dovish pivot! The key is what he said afterward: he didn’t rule out another move in December; he just no longer wanted to give the market “clear guidance.” In other words, from now on, it’s all about the data—no more signals telling you it’s safe to relax in advance.

The market reacted immediately: BTC rallied briefly, but trading volume didn’t pick up.
This kind of “temporary sigh of relief” can be misleading. It doesn’t mean liquidity is about to flood the market; it just means short-term expectations have eased.
Don’t get carried away and rush in. With such a vague statement, a single stronger-than-expected data point could make him change his tune at any moment.
Keep your hands steady and wait patiently for a clear direction to emerge.

📰 How Did an Adviser Who Helped Pass the Stablecoin Bill Make Money? WSJ Investigation Raises Red Flags for Crypto Regulation

The Wall Street Journal revealed that a joint venture involving Bo Hines, a former crypto adviser in the Trump administration, profited after the GENIUS stablecoin bill he helped advance was passed. The news has drawn attention to potential conflicts of interest behind the approval of the stablecoin bill, particularly the possible ripple effects on industry regulation.

Why does this news matter?
The passage of the GENIUS Act is seen as an important step toward regulating stablecoins in the United States, but Bo Hines’s financial benefit has challenged the public perception of “independent and objective regulation.” This reflects:
1. The widespread difficulty of fully separating lobbying power from the legislative process in the U.S. system
2. A clear example of the risk of conflicts of interest in legislating crypto industry regulation
3. How the regulatory path for stablecoins, as financial infrastructure, directly affects the flow of market capital

What does this mean? The “revolving door” effect in crypto may be more pronounced than in traditional financial markets, because the industry innovates rapidly and its participants come from more diverse backgrounds. If regulators can profit from legislation, they may be more inclined in the future to make rules that benefit established players rather than newcomers.

Market impact
In the short term, this could heighten concerns about regulatory uncertainty in crypto markets and intensify risk-aversion among investors. Potential transmission channels include:
- Policy risks in the stablecoin sector spilling over into the broader crypto market
- Expectations of tighter regulation potentially prompting outflows of BTC/ETH held in stablecoins
- Institutional investors becoming more cautious about taking part in discussions related to regulation

There are few historical parallels, but one possible reference is Facebook’s successful lobbying for EU data privacy legislation in 2017, followed by its founding team benefiting from it. However, stablecoin regulation is unique because it involves multiple regulatory responsibilities, including payment systems and monetary policy, making potential conflicts of interest more complex.

Trading approach
💡 The impact of this news on crypto market sentiment may persist for 1–2 weeks, with the main effects concentrated in regulation-sensitive assets such as ETH and BTC, given their close links to stablecoins. This pressure may ease if the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission subsequently makes clear that it will bring the GENIUS Act under its regulatory framework.

This assessment would no longer apply if regulators carried out a large-scale removal of commissioners involved in conflicts of interest.

📰 帮通过稳定币法案的顾问怎么赚钱？WSJ调查给加密监管亮红灯

华尔街日报曝光了前特朗普政府加密顾问Bo Hines参与的GENIUS稳定币法案通过后，其合资公司从中获利。这件事让市场开始关注稳定币法案审批背后的利益冲突问题，尤其是对行业监管可能产生的连锁反应。

为什么这条新闻重要？
GENIUS法案的通过被视为美国稳定币监管迈出的重要一步，但Bo Hines的受益情况打破了"监管独立客观"的公众认知。这背后反映的是：
1. 美国立法体系中，游说力量与立法进程难以完全隔离的普遍问题
2. 加密行业监管在立法层面存在利益输送风险的典型案例
3. 稳定币作为金融基础设施，其监管路径直接关系到市场资金流向

这件事意味着什么？监管的"旋转门"效应在加密领域可能比传统金融市场更明显，因为行业创新速度快、参与者背景更多元。如果监管者能从立法中获益，可能会在未来更倾向于制定有利于现有玩家（而非新兴参与者）的规则。

对市场的影响
短期来看，这件事可能会加剧加密市场对监管不确定性的担忧，导致资金避险情绪升温。具体传导路径可能包括：
- 稳定币领域的政策风险外溢至整个加密市场
- 监管收紧预期可能导致持有稳定币的BTC/ETH资金流出
- 机构投资者在参与监管相关讨论时可能更加谨慎

历史上类似事件参考较少，但可以参考2017年Facebook游说欧盟数据隐私法案获得成功，其创始团队后续从中获利的案例。不过稳定币监管的特殊性在于其涉及支付系统、货币政策等多重监管权责，潜在的利益冲突更为复杂。

操作思路
💡 这件事对加密市场情绪的压制效应可能持续1-2周，主要影响集中在监管敏感币种如ETH和BTC，因为它们与稳定币的关联度最高。如果后续美国证券交易委员会明确将GENIUS法案纳入其监管框架，这种压力可能缓解。

如果出现监管机构大规模撤换涉及利益冲突的委员，这个判断作废。

Ethereum shows an hourly direction down while its trading volume remains above its baseline. This combination raises a question about what matters more: the direction of the move or how well that move holds under strong activity.

The peer set includes Bitcoin, which also displays a down hourly direction with volume above baseline, and Amp, which moves up hourly with volume similarly elevated. The shared volume level suggests active market participation, yet the opposite directions highlight that volume alone does not dictate price path.

A shared direction is not proven by the observed volume pattern. The data does not reveal any causal link such as capital rotation, sector effects, or a common catalyst. Therefore, the parallel volume levels cannot be taken as evidence of correlation between the assets.

## Mechanism focus
When volume exceeds the typical baseline, it can provide liquidity that supports price moves, whether up or down. However, the sustainability of the move depends on whether buyers or sellers dominate the order flow. Observing how quickly the price retraces after the initial direction can indicate the strength of that dominance.

Track the next few hourly candles for ETH and note if the down move persists as volume stays high. A reversal would suggest that volume alone was insufficient to hold the direction, shifting the emphasis toward market sentiment rather than raw activity.

ETH: Assess the risk boundaries first | Unichain operational migration gets a new proposal | Don’t call a bottom before 2390 gives way

My stance is to watch cautiously, and not treat an infrastructure change as an immediate tailwind for ETH. On October 16, an OP Labs engineer submitted a proposal to the Optimism governance forum for a Unichain mainnet maintenance upgrade. The goal is to support the planned October 29 transfer of sequencer operations from Uniswap Labs to OP Enterprise, operated by the Optimism Foundation. The proposal covers rotating proposers for the fallback dispute game, changing the fee-receiving address responsible for L1 data costs, and configuring the operating-expense treasury. It still needs to go through governance and be implemented. For now, all we can say is that a plan has been proposed and a target date set—not that the migration is complete. An earlier announcement from Uniswap Labs also confirmed the October 29 mainnet migration target and said the chain ID, contracts, balances, and applications would remain unchanged.

Why is ETH worth watching? Unichain is an Ethereum Layer 2, so its sequencing, data submissions, and cross-chain experience affect application costs and the efficiency of fund transfers. If the operational handover goes smoothly, native OP Stack interoperability could eventually start with ETH assets. But the planned ability to “transfer without a traditional bridge” is a future capability, not something that is already live today. More importantly, the maintenance proposal explicitly says it will not change user-facing protocol behavior, bridge security, or existing revenue sharing. The L1 cost share moves with the operator responsible for paying those costs; this does not suddenly create a new dividend for ETH. Interpreting the operational handover as an immediate source of guaranteed buying pressure for ETH is a leap in logic.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD was trading at around $2,392 on Kraken, down over the past 24 hours from an opening price of about $2,439, with a low of 2390 and a high of 2491. The price is close to the bottom of its range, but the decline cannot be attributed solely to this governance proposal; macro conditions, leverage, and overall risk appetite may also be contributing. 2390 is the immediate support level, 2439 is the level to watch for a move back above the day’s opening price, and 2491 is resistance overhead. These levels should not be dressed up as guaranteed reversal points.

If I were trading this myself: I would not try to buy the dip right now. My short-term bias is neutral, and my position size is 0%. Only if ETH regains and holds above 2439, then retests it without breaking below, while market risk appetite also improves, would I consider opening a 5% spot position based on total capital. The first target would be 2491; I’d take half off there and watch to see whether the rest could continue higher on increasing volume. If the price fell back below 2390 after entry, I’d stop out and close the position. Even if no entry trigger occurs, a break below 2390 would cancel the bullish plan: no averaging down and no leverage. Conversely, if the October 29 migration is delayed, governance rejects the proposal, or user assets are put at risk, the original improving outlook would need to be reconsidered. News is just news; any discussion of trades or profits must wait for actual triggers.

#ETH #UNI
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把基础设施调整当成ETH的即时利好。10月16日，OP Labs工程师在Optimism治理论坛提交Unichain主网维护升级提案，目标是配合10月29日将排序器运营从Uniswap Labs转向Optimism Foundation的OP Enterprise。提案涉及备用争议游戏的提议者轮换、承担L1数据成本的费用接收地址调整，以及运营费用金库配置。它还需要治理流程与实际执行；现在只能说“提出方案、设定目标”，不能说迁移已经完成。Uniswap Labs此前的公告也确认了10月29日的主网迁移目标，并称链ID、合约、余额和应用保持不变。

为什么ETH值得关注？Unichain是以太坊二层，排序、数据提交和跨链体验影响的是应用使用成本与资金流转效率。若运营交接顺利，未来OP Stack原生互操作有望先从ETH资产开始，但“以后可无需传统桥转移”是规划中的能力，不等于今天已开放。更重要的是，这次维护提案明确称不改变用户端协议行为、桥安全和现有收益分成；L1成本份额随支付成本的运营方转移，不是突然给ETH新增分红。把运营交接解读成ETH立刻获得确定买盘，逻辑跳得太快。

市场已怎样反应？写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2392美元，过去24小时从开盘约2439美元走弱，低点2390、高点2491。价格正在贴近区间下沿，但不能把跌幅单因归于这份治理提案；同期宏观、杠杆和整体风险偏好都可能扰动。2390是眼前防守线，2439是重新站回当日开盘的观察线，2491是上方压力，不把这些数字包装成必然反转位。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与抄底，方向暂时中性，持仓比例0%。只有ETH重新站稳2439并回踩不破、同时市场风险偏好改善，我才考虑用总资金的5%做现货试仓；第一目标2491，触及先减半，剩余看能否继续放量上行。若入场后跌回2390下方，直接止损清仓；即使未触发入场，若2390失守也取消多头计划，不补仓、不加杠杆。反过来，若10月29日迁移延期、治理遭否决或出现用户资产风险，原本的改善判断也要推翻。消息归消息，成交与盈利都必须等真实触发后才能谈。

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Bulls and Bears Clash Amid ETF Withdrawals and Institutional Maneuvering

I. Price Action Review

As of October 16, 2026, Beijing time, Ethereum’s spot price stood at $2,439, down approximately 0.11% over the past 24 hours. After opening at $2,463, the price gradually declined intraday, touching a low of $2,421.5 and generally trending lower amid volatility. On the hourly chart, ETH briefly rebounded above $2,480 during the Asian session but failed to hold there and soon pulled back. The decline accelerated during the European and U.S. sessions, with the price breaking below several moving-average supports in succession. Trading volume also increased during the decline, with turnover reaching $44.15 million, indicating strong selling pressure and weak market confidence.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving-average system shows a clear bearish trend. The 7-day MA is at $2,449, the 25-day MA at $2,449, and the 99-day MA at $2,461. The price has fallen below all three moving averages. Exponential moving averages are also weakening: the 7-day EMA has dropped rapidly to $2,441 and is converging with the 25-day EMA at $2,442. If the decline continues, a confirmed death cross may form.

The Bollinger Bands show that the price has fallen to near the lower band at $2,420. The middle band is at $2,448, and the upper band is at $2,475. The bands have widened somewhat, indicating increased volatility. The price’s approach toward the lower band suggests that the short-term weakness may persist.

The MACD histogram has turned negative at -4.49, and the DIFF line is increasingly likely to cross below the signal line, with bearish momentum continuing to build. The 6-period RSI has plunged to 25.2 from a previous high of 79.4, signaling extremely strong short-term oversold conditions. In the KDJ indicator, K is 17.07, D is 33.65, and J is -16.08. All three lines are falling rapidly, and J has moved deep into negative territory, indicating an extremely oversold market.

The Williams %R (WR) has fallen to -98.83, while the Stochastic RSI has dropped to an extremely low 0.60. Multiple technical indicators are therefore flashing oversold warnings at the same time. However, it is important to remember that oversold does not mean an immediate reversal: during a sustained downtrend, indicators may remain in oversold territory for an extended period.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The biggest headwind currently facing Ethereum comes from the ETF market. On October 14, VanEck formally withdrew its registration application for a Lido staked Ethereum ETF, nearly a year after its initial S-1 filing, citing the SEC’s continued failure to declare the filing effective. The move reflects regulators’ ongoing caution toward staked ETH products. Meanwhile, spot Ethereum ETFs have seen outflows for several consecutive days: net outflows totaled $129.5 million on October 14 and $60.22 million on October 15, with BlackRock’s ETHA leading the decline with a single-day outflow of $44.4 million.

However, institutional activity has not stopped. Charles Schwab has enabled ETH trading for approximately 40 million retail clients, and Deutsche Bank has announced plans to launch Ethereum custody services. On-chain data shows that large entities acquired a cumulative 53,095 ETH over the past five days through BTC swaps. In addition, large amounts of ETH have moved from exchanges into cold-wallet custody, suggesting that long-term holders are still buying the dip.

The divergence between technical and fundamental factors is worth watching. On one hand, several indicators are in extremely oversold territory, increasing the likelihood of a short-term rebound. On the other hand, continued ETF outflows and regulatory uncertainty pose medium-term pressure. $2,420 is the key support level at present; a decisive break below it could lead to a test of the $2,300 level. Investors should exercise caution and wait for clear signs of stabilization before making decisions.

content:
以太坊市场深度分析：ETF撤单与机构博弈下的多空较量

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间二零二六年十月十六日，以太坊现货价格报两千四百三十九美元，过去二十四小时微跌约百分之零点一一。盘中价格从两千四百六十三美元开盘后逐步走低，最低触及两千四百二十一点五美元，整体呈现震荡下行格局。从小时K线来看，ETH在亚盘时段曾短暂反弹至两千四百八十美元上方，但未能站稳随即回落，欧美盘时段加速下跌，连续跌破多条均线支撑。成交量方面，下跌阶段成交额放大至四千四百一十五万美元，显示空方主导力度较强，市场信心不足。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头格局。七日MA位于两千四百四十九美元，二十五日MA位于两千四百四十九美元，九十九日MA位于两千四百六十一美元，价格已全面跌穿三条均线。指数移动均线同样走弱，七日EMA快速下行至两千四百四十一美元，与二十五日EMA两千四百四十二美元趋于粘合，若继续下行将形成死叉确认。

布林带指标显示价格已跌至下轨两千四百二十美元附近，中轨位于两千四百四十八美元，上轨位于两千四百七十五美元。带宽有所扩大，表明波动性增加，价格向下轨靠拢意味着短期弱势格局延续。

MACD指标方面，柱状图转为负四点四九，DIFF线从上方向下穿越信号线的趋势愈发明确，空头动能持续增强。RSI六周期指标骤降至二十五点二，从此前的高位七十九点四大幅回落，显示短期超卖信号极为强烈。KDJ指标中K值为十七点零七，D值为三十三点六五，J值为负十六点零八，三线快速下行且J值已深入负值区域，表明市场处于极度超卖状态。

威廉指标WR降至负九十八点八三，随机RSI降至零点六零的极端低位，多项技术指标同时发出超卖警报。不过需要注意的是，超卖并不等于立即反转，在趋势性下跌中，指标可能长时间停留在超卖区域。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的最大利空来自ETF市场。VanEck于十月十四日正式撤回了其Lido质押以太坊ETF的注册申请，距首次提交S-1文件已近一年时间，理由是SEC始终未宣布该文件生效。这一事件反映出监管机构对质押类ETH产品仍持谨慎态度。与此同时，现货以太坊ETF连续多日遭遇资金流出，十月十四日净流出一点二九五亿美元，十月十五日净流出六千零二十二万美元，其中贝莱德ETHA单日流出四千四百四十万美元领跌。

然而机构层面的布局并未停止。嘉信理财已为约四千万零售客户开通ETH交易功能，德意志银行也宣布即将推出以太坊托管服务。链上数据显示，大型实体在过去五天通过BTC置换方式累计购入五万三千零九十五枚ETH，同时大量ETH从交易所转入冷钱包托管，显示长期持有者仍在逢低吸纳。

技术面与基本面的背离值得关注。一方面多项指标处于极端超卖区域，短线反弹概率增加；另一方面ETF持续流出和监管不确定性构成中期压力。两千四百二十美元为当前关键支撑位，若有效跌破则可能下探两千三百美元一线。投资者在操作中应保持谨慎，等待明确的企稳信号再做决策。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script is almost the same in every market cycle:
① Doubt: Prices have risen for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone is calling it a dead-cat bounce and saying to sell into the rally.
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors get in with one foot still out the door.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group chat start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is skyrocketing.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy correction—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge day after day, and everyone is selling at a loss—and this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

October 17 Morning Market Brief
As of 07:30 Beijing time

1) The crypto market remained weak overnight, but has not yet broadly lost momentum. BTC was around $81,630, down 0.69% over 24 hours; ETH around $2,424, down 0.80%; SOL around $104.3, down 1.05%; and BNB around $723, down 0.88%. XRP and ADA fell more sharply, by around 1.81% and 1.95%, respectively. The key point is that the broader market’s pullback remains concentrated in the 1%–2% range, with no widespread surge in volatility so far. In today’s Asian session, first watch whether BTC can hold near $81,000 and whether ETH/BTC continues to weaken.

2) Altcoins are relatively more vulnerable. Among the highly liquid USDT trading pairs, XRP and ADA fell noticeably more than BTC, while SOL also underperformed the broader market. Investor preference remains concentrated in large-cap assets and cash. If BTC moves sideways while altcoins continue to fall, that would indicate risk appetite has yet to recover. Today, watch whether ETH and SOL can stabilize while BTC moves sideways, and whether trading volume shifts back toward major coins.

3) US stocks ended a weak week, with tech and chip stocks the main drags. US stocks closed lower on Friday as AI and semiconductor shares continued to retreat, and the market began to question whether high valuations can be justified by future earnings. For crypto, the implication is that further declines in the Nasdaq and chip stocks would typically weigh on high-beta crypto assets. In today’s Asian session, watch the correlation with Japanese and South Korean tech stocks and Nasdaq futures, rather than focusing only on crypto prices.

4) The AI trade is becoming less crowded. Overnight reports showed that the selloff in chip stocks had spread from a single company to the broader sector, with the market increasingly focused on the payback period for data center and AI investment. This affects not only tech stocks, but also growth stocks, altcoins, and mining company valuations. If chips stabilize today but BTC fails to follow, that divergence would instead suggest that crypto-specific investors remain cautious.

5) Oil prices still carry a risk premium related to the Middle East and the Strait of Hormuz. Uncertainty around shipping routes is raising the tail risk of higher energy prices, which could push up inflation expectations and Treasury yields, thereby compressing valuations for high-priced assets. Today, watch whether oil prices, the US dollar, and real interest rates strengthen in tandem. If oil rises while tech weakens, crypto is more likely to see feeble rebounds than a trend reversal.

6) The signal from Fed Chair Warsh leaned toward “data dependence,” with no advance commitment to the rate path for October or December. The market will therefore continue to reprice expectations around inflation, oil prices, and employment. For BTC, the key is not the remarks themselves, but whether Treasury yields and the US dollar continue to rise. In today’s Asian session, first watch the dollar’s direction, then assess the quality of any rebound in risk assets.

7) ETF flows diverged: on Thursday, spot Bitcoin ETFs saw only modest net inflows of around $5 million, after outflows of around $261 million the previous day. Ethereum ETFs saw net outflows of around $60 million, while Solana products also recorded consecutive outflows. This suggests BTC may be showing signs of stabilizing, but institutional buying has yet to provide sustained confirmation. Watch the next US-session flow data today. If BTC rises without ETF support, be more cautious about chasing the rally.

8) The weekend macro calendar is relatively quiet; the real window to watch is next week. Today’s main event is speeches by European Central Bank officials, with relatively little in the way of data releases. On Monday morning Beijing time, China will release third-quarter GDP, industrial production, retail sales, and other activity data. These could affect the renminbi, Hong Kong and Chinese stocks, commodities, and Asian risk appetite simultaneously, with knock-on effects for liquidity in crypto at the start of the week. Over the weekend, don’t mistake sharp moves in thin liquidity for confirmation of a trend.

In a nutshell: The market currently looks more like “BTC range-bound, altcoins under pressure, and external risk appetite weak”—a night before a potential recovery. Today, first watch support near $81,000, ETH/BTC relative strength, Nasdaq futures, and oil prices; then wait for ETF flows and next week’s China data to provide direction.

10月17日早间市场快报
截至北京时间 07:30

1）隔夜加密市场继续偏弱，但还不是全面失速。BTC 约 81,630 美元，24小时 -0.69%；ETH 约 2,424 美元，-0.80%；SOL 约 104.3 美元，-1.05%；BNB 约 723 美元，-0.88%。XRP、ADA 跌幅更大，分别约 -1.81%、-1.95%。重要性在于大盘回撤仍集中在 1%-2% 区间，尚未出现高波动扩散；今天亚洲盘先看 BTC 能否守住 8.1 万美元附近，以及 ETH/BTC 是否继续走弱。

2）山寨币相对更脆弱。高流动性 USDT 交易对中，XRP、ADA 跌幅明显高于 BTC，SOL 也跑输大盘。资金偏好仍集中在大市值和现金，若 BTC 横盘而山寨继续走低，说明风险承受力没有修复。今天看 BTC 横盘时 ETH、SOL 能否止跌，以及成交量是否重新回到主流币。

3）美股结束一周弱势，科技和芯片是主要拖累。美股周五收低，AI 与半导体板块继续回撤，市场开始质疑高估值能否被后续盈利兑现。对币圈的含义是：纳指/芯片股若继续下行，通常会压制高贝塔加密资产；今天亚洲盘关注日韩科技股和纳指期货的联动，而不是只看币价本身。

4）AI 交易的拥挤度正在降温。隔夜报道显示，芯片股下跌已从单一公司扩散到板块，市场更在意数据中心和 AI 投入的回报周期。它影响的不只是科技股，也会影响成长股、山寨币和矿企估值。今天若出现“芯片止跌但 BTC 不跟”的背离，反而说明加密市场自身资金仍偏谨慎。

5）油价仍带着中东与霍尔木兹海峡风险溢价。油运通道不确定性抬高能源价格尾部风险，可能推升通胀预期和美债收益率，进而压缩高估值资产的估值空间。今天看油价与美元、实际利率是否同向走强；若油强、科技弱，币圈更容易出现反弹乏力而非趋势反转。

6）美联储主席 Warsh 释放的信号偏“数据依赖”，没有提前承诺10月或12月利率路径。市场因此仍会围绕通胀、油价和就业重新定价。对 BTC 来说，关键不是一句讲话本身，而是美债收益率和美元是否继续上行；今天亚洲盘先观察美元强弱，再判断风险资产反弹质量。

ETH cross-chain routing reaches a deadline｜Metis liquidity pools require different handling by type｜I’m prioritizing risk control, not chasing a rebound

My stance is cautious: I’m treating “cross-chain route exits” and “problems with the ETH network” as separate issues. METIS appeared in Binance Square’s Most Searched section, and Binance News reminded Stargate liquidity providers to pay attention to October 23. Metis’s official website says that support for Stargate on Andromeda ends on October 23, and that LayerZero Labs’ existing DVN and Executor will stop serving the network on October 30. Those dates haven’t arrived yet; the services have not already stopped today, and the Ethereum mainnet is not shutting down.

The issue directly related to ETH concerns Stargate V2’s ETH pool. If you hold LP shares in that pool, the official instructions are to unstake first, then withdraw the underlying assets before October 23. Exiting depends on the pool’s liquidity at the time. By contrast, if you simply hold WETH on Andromeda via Metis’s official bridge, the official guidance explicitly says no action is needed because of this change, and the official bridge between Ethereum and Metis will continue operating. Both are “ETH-related assets,” but one is a third-party LP share and the other is WETH issued through the official bridge. Don’t follow withdrawal instructions based on the token name alone.

Metis’s technical migration guide says that applications using LayerZero V2 which still rely on the old verifiers and executor need to configure the new services and test in both directions before October 30. The old V1 route cannot switch directly to the new configuration. This affects specific cross-chain routes; it is not an Ethereum consensus failure. Ordinary traders should first check the chain, bridge, type of share, and whether the recipient supports it. Don’t sell all your WETH just because of a breaking-news alert, and don’t chase “migration arbitrage” when you don’t understand the contract.

From a market perspective, this kind of event is more likely to affect local liquidity and cross-chain costs; it doesn’t directly imply buying across the entire ETH market. At the time of writing, ETH was around $2,420 on Kraken, below the day’s open of about $2,439, with a rolling 24-hour range of roughly $2,390–$2,491; METIS was around $3.92. Prices are fluctuating, but there’s no evidence that Metis’s service changes alone caused ETH’s pullback. Most line items in Farside’s October 16 ETH ETF table were still dashes, and the webpage’s automatically calculated total of 0.0 should not be presented as confirmed zero fund flows. My short-term levels to watch are $2,390 support, a reclaim-and-hold level near the $2,440 daily open, and resistance above $2,490. If $2,390 breaks, the basis for a rebound is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter ETH directly because of this news. My directional bias would be for a small spot long only. I’d place a trial trade using about 4% of my total capital only if a four-hour candle closes back above $2,440 and the price subsequently retests that level without breaking below it. I’d take half off near the first target of $2,490, reduce further near the second target of $2,550, and use a trailing take-profit for the remainder. After entry, I’d stop out if a four-hour candle closes below $2,410. If two attempts to break above $2,490 are rejected, or a credible new announcement reports an issue with the official bridge, I’d immediately close the remaining position. If the price first breaks below $2,390, I’d cancel the entire long setup and stay on the sidelines—no leverage and no betting on the speed of an exit with cross-chain LP positions.

Sources: Metis’s October 5 official announcement and technical migration guide, Binance News, Kraken ETH/METIS quotes, and Farside’s ETH ETF table. #ETH #METIS
This is solely my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是审慎，把“跨链路线退出”与“ETH网络出问题”分开看。币安广场Most Searched出现METIS，Binance News提醒Stargate流动性提供者留意10月23日。Metis官网说明：10月23日结束Stargate在Andromeda上的支持，10月30日LayerZero Labs原有DVN和Executor停止服务该网络。日期尚未到，不是今天已停，更不是以太坊主网关闭。

与ETH直接相关的是Stargate V2的ETH池。若持有该池LP份额，官方要求先解除质押，再于10月23日前提取底层资产；退出取决于当时的池内流动性。相反，只是通过Metis官方桥持有Andromeda上的WETH，官方明确说无需因本次调整而操作，Ethereum与Metis之间的官方桥继续运作。两者都叫“ETH相关资产”，一个是第三方LP份额，一个是官方桥发行的WETH，不能只看币名就照搬撤资指令。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Position Compounding: Fortune Favors the Bold—or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Position compounding” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound it a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What position compounding involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for a new position and keep adding to your trades,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
a few dozen points to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The mathematical truth】Position compounding is fundamentally about “being right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% win rate on each trade, the odds of getting four wins in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

以太坊市场深度分析：技术面承压明显，ETF资金外流加剧短期困境

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月十七日凌晨，以太坊现货报价二千四百二十四美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点六三。价格在此前触及二千四百七十七美元的日内高点后遭遇强烈抛压，快速回落至二千三百九十八美元的日内低点，随后小幅反弹至二千四百二十五美元附近企稳。从小时级别K线观察，最近五根K线呈现窄幅震荡格局，实体极小，上下影线较短，显示多空双方暂时达成平衡。布林带指标显示上轨位于二千四百八十一美元，中轨位于二千四百四十美元，下轨位于二千三百九十九美元，价格在中轨与下轨之间运行，偏弱格局明显。成交量方面，从一千九百二十八万美元逐步萎缩至不足八百万美元，量能萎缩反映市场参与意愿降低，观望情绪浓厚。

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。
