translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position—but how? Starting with a huge position and adding until you’ve used up all your unrealized profits is a sure way to become a
regular on the liquidation list. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
Confirm, then add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position becomes, keeping your average cost low so you can withstand pullbacks.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you lose your composure, every trade goes off the rails.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Survive Long-Term
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losing trades, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. But if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it just to break even—the math has practically written you off.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

Who would have thought that a puzzle that had puzzled the cryptography community for over 25 years would be solved by AI in under 30 minutes? 🔐

Anthropic just revealed that Claude uncovered the true origins of the “seeds” for several NIST elliptic curves.

🔹 The five curves involved are P-192, P-224, P-256, P-384, and P-521. They were added to the ECDSA signature standard in 2000 and are used in TLS certificates, SSH, and more.
🔹 Back then, only the seed values were published, with no explanation of how they were generated. Speculation over whether they concealed a backdoor has raged for more than two decades.
🔹 Claude’s answer: they weren’t hashes of some secret phrase, but outputs from lrand48, an old random number generator in 1990s C libraries, initialized with Unix timestamps from 1997–1998. All five seeds were reproduced.

The key point: this isn’t a crack, and it doesn’t weaken the security of these curves. On the contrary, making the seeds’ origins reproducible makes the claim that someone “deliberately planted a backdoor” much harder to defend.

For the crypto world, Bitcoin and Ethereum use secp256k1, which isn’t one of these five curves in the first place. What’s really worth thinking about is something else: AI is now digging through old records and spotting patterns so quickly that it’s a little unsettling.

Do you think AI will first become an ally in cryptographic security—or a new threat? 👇

#AI和半导体股本周市值损失超1万亿美元 #BTC #ETH

content:
没想到，一个困扰密码学圈 25 年多的谜题，被 AI 用不到 30 分钟解开了🔐

Anthropic 最新披露：Claude 找到了 NIST 那几条椭圆曲线「种子」的真正来历。

🔹 涉及 P-192、P-224、P-256、P-384、P-521 五条曲线，2000 年被写进 ECDSA 签名标准，TLS 证书、SSH 等都在用
🔹 这些种子当年只公布了数值，从没说明是怎么来的，“是不是藏了后门”的猜测吵了二十多年
🔹 Claude 给出的答案：不是什么暗语的哈希，而是 1990 年代 C 语言库里的老随机数生成器 lrand48，用 1997–1998 年的 Unix 时间戳初始化后的输出，五个种子全部复现

划重点：这不是破解，也没有削弱这些曲线的安全性。反过来，种子来源变得可复现，“故意埋后门”的说法基本站不住了。

对币圈来说，比特币和以太坊用的是 secp256k1，本来就不在这五条曲线里。真正值得琢磨的是另一件事：AI 翻老账、找规律的速度，已经快到让人有点发怵。

你觉得 AI 会先成为加密安全的帮手，还是新的威胁？👇

translatedData.title: Scale out of your position: How to lock in profits while letting them run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking strategy I always use.

【Three stages】Part 1: When it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Part 2: When it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another 1/3. Part 3: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you sell your entire position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you'll often ride the elevator all the way back to square one.

📉 This time, the price fell below $80K and bounced back to $82K—$BTC  gave the market a solid lesson

The biggest lesson this week wasn’t “how hot the inflation data was,” but “how fragile leverage can be.” U.S. CPI came in hotter than expected, and PPI surged to 6.3%, fueling bets on Fed rate hikes. In just a few minutes, the market wiped out nearly $1 billion in long positions. Liquidations over the past 24 hours hit a recent high, with longs accounting for 80% of the total. The price is back around $81,600, but BTC open interest has already fallen more than 14% from its peak of 87,000. Where leverage gets flushed out is often where the next trend gets its cleanest start.

My short take is straightforward:

First, don’t try to catch a falling knife, but don’t chase shorts here either. After the $80K psychological level held twice, both bulls and bears have become cautious. In this kind of market, a choppy recovery is more likely than a V-shaped reversal.

Second, ETF flows are speaking for themselves. Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $261 million in outflows on a single day midweek, and only managed to turn slightly positive yesterday. Ethereum ETFs have seen net outflows for several consecutive days. Institutional money is “waiting,” not “buying.” A price rebound needs real money to sustain it; otherwise, it’s just a short-covering rally.

Third, the risk isn’t over. The next cards to watch are the details of the GENIUS Act on October 31 and the Fed’s subsequent statements. Once stablecoin regulations are in place, crypto could gain a new “compliant channel for capital to enter”—the only factor that could materially change supply and demand by the end of 2026.

Whether $80K can become the solid floor for this cycle depends on whether ETFs see consecutive days of net inflows next week. What do you think: is this a turning point after leverage has been flushed out, or just a mid-cycle pause in the bear market?

ETH Upgrade Testing Continues｜Gas Repricing Raises Contract Compatibility Risks｜Wait for Confirmation Near $2,414

My stance is to watch cautiously and not treat testnet progress as a direct buy signal for spot ETH. The Ethereum Foundation announced on October 16 that Glamsterdam is scheduled to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26; the mainnet date has not yet been determined. We already discussed the testing timeline earlier this morning. What’s more worth noting this time is another point in the announcement: EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 adjust the Gas pricing for creating and reading on-chain state. The Foundation’s earlier contract impact analysis said that replaying historical mainnet transactions showed that the vast majority of contracts would be unaffected, but a small number could fail or degrade because they hardcode Gas limits. Some issues may only require raising the limit, while others would require changes to the logic. This is testing and compatibility checking—not a change to mainnet pricing today, and certainly not a reason for ETH holders to migrate on-chain now.

Why does this detail matter to the market? More accurate resource pricing is one condition for increasing L1 processing capacity. But if wallet estimates, default frontend limits, and legacy contracts don’t keep pace, the user experience could temporarily suffer during the upgrade. Developers need to retest on the testnet; traders should account for both the “long-term scaling outlook” and “short-term execution risks” in their expectations. You can’t look only at the block Gas limit and conclude that fees will immediately fall or demand for ETH will immediately rise. The Foundation’s explanation also specifically mentions assumptions about fixed 2,300 Gas transfers, hardcoded call limits, and paths that depend on gasleft(). The impact is limited to a small number of cases, so it shouldn’t be exaggerated into a claim that contracts across the network are failing. Going forward, watch for compatible client versions, test results, and an official mainnet date—not a catchy upgrade narrative used to book gains in advance.

On price, when I checked ETH/USD on Kraken, it was around $2,414, with a daily open near $2,439 and a 24-hour low around $2,390 and high around $2,491. The price is below the daily open, which suggests the market has at least not begun a sustained one-way rally in response to this announcement, but the pullback cannot be attributed to the upgrade alone. $2,400 is the nearest psychological level, and $2,390 is the low already reached. Above that, the first level to watch is the $2,439 daily open, followed by the previously reached high near $2,490. These are reference levels, not guaranteed execution prices. If the price falls below $2,390 and cannot quickly recover, the short-term bullish view is invalidated. A more credible confirmation than “buying just because an upgrade was announced” would be a high-volume move back above $2,439 that holds.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot position; I would not use high leverage. I’d enter in batches using 3% of total capital only if the price regains and holds above $2,439, pulls back without breaking below it, and there are no new client-risk announcements. The first target is $2,470, where I’d sell half; the second is near $2,490, where I’d reduce the position further if the price meets resistance. I’d place the initial stop-loss below $2,390, taking actual execution slippage into account. If the price falls below $2,390, testing reveals major compatibility issues, or the price fails to stay above $2,439 for 24 hours after entry, I’d close the position rather than force the plan into a long-term conviction trade. If the conditions aren’t met, I stay in cash—observation shouldn’t be written up as profit.

#ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH升级测试继续推进｜Gas重定价牵出合约兼容风险｜2414美元附近先等确认

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把测试网进度直接翻译成现货买入信号。以太坊基金会10月16日公告，Glamsterdam计划在10月26日于Hoodi测试网激活，主网日期仍未确定。凌晨已经谈过测试时间，这次更值得看的是公告里的另一条线：EIP-8037、8038调整创建和读取链上状态的Gas计价。基金会此前的合约影响说明称，历史主网交易重放后，绝大多数合约不受影响，但少量合约可能因写死Gas额度而失败或退化，部分问题只需提高限额，部分需要修改逻辑。这是测试和兼容性排查，不是今天主网已经改价，更不是ETH持有人现在要做链上迁移。

这个细节为何与市场有关？更准确的资源定价是提高L1处理能力的条件之一，但如果钱包估算、前端默认限额和老合约没有跟上，用户体验可能在升级时短暂受损。开发者需要在测试网复测；交易员则需要把“长期扩容想象”与“短期执行风险”同时放进预期，不能只看区块Gas上限就推导出手续费立刻下降或ETH需求立刻上升。基金会的说明还特别提到固定2300 Gas转账假设、硬编码调用额度及依赖gasleft()的路径，影响范围是小部分，不宜夸大成全网合约故障。后续应观察客户端兼容版本、测试结果与正式主网日期，而不是靠一句升级叙事提前结算收益。

价格上，我查Kraken ETH/USD时约2414美元，日开约2439，近24小时低位约2390、高位约2491；价格低于日开，说明市场至少没有因这条公告形成持续单边上行，但不能把回落单独归因于升级。2400是当前最近的心理关口，2390是已见低点；上方先看2439日开，再看2490附近的已见高点。这些是观察位置，不是保证会成交的报价。如果跌破2390后不能迅速收回，短线偏强判断就被推翻；若放量站回2439并维持，才算出现比“听到升级就追”更可信的确认。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓试多，不做高杠杆。仅在价格重新站稳2439、回踩不破且市场没有新的客户端风险公告时，才用总资金的3%分批入场；第一目标2470，届时减半，第二目标2490附近，遇阻再减仓。初始止损放在2390下方且以实际成交滑点为准；若跌破2390、测试暴露重大兼容问题，或买入后24小时仍无法维持在2439上方，我会平仓而不是把计划硬改成长线信仰。若条件未触发，就是空仓，不把观察写成利润。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

🐋 Beyond watching the markets, here’s something else you should know: Ethereum’s ERC-20 standard
ERC-20 is the interface standard for fungible tokens on Ethereum. The corresponding proposal, EIP-20, was introduced in November 2015.
The point of a unified standard is composability: wallets, exchanges, and DeFi protocols all use the same interface to interact with tokens, so newly issued tokens can be supported right away.
ERC-20 tokens run on Ethereum, and transfers require $ETH  to pay Gas.
Be skeptical of projects promising stable, high returns.

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Significant Short-Term Pressure, but Bottom Support Is Gradually Strengthening

I. Price Action Analysis

As of October 16, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $2,415, down approximately 1.86% over the past 24 hours. During the Asian session, the price briefly fell to a recent low of $2,393, then found support near the $2,400 level and rebounded to trade in a narrow range around $2,419. On the hourly chart, volatility has gradually narrowed over the past five periods, while trading volume has fallen from around $50 million to around $7 million. This suggests selling pressure is easing, though buyers remain cautious.

Ethereum has faced pressure this week from two main sources. First, large holders have transferred significant amounts of ETH to exchanges, including a whale deposit of 15,361 ETH that fueled concerns about potential selling. Second, spot Ethereum ETFs saw $60.3 million in net outflows on October 15, following a single-day redemption of $129.5 million, with continued institutional withdrawals weighing heavily on the price. However, traditional financial institutions such as Charles Schwab opening up crypto trading, along with the expansion of bank custody services, are providing fundamental support for Ethereum.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving-average system shows a classic bearish alignment. The 7-day moving average at $2,419 is below the 25-day average at $2,443, which is in turn below the 99-day average at $2,457. The price is trading below all major moving averages, indicating a weak short-term trend. The exponential moving average confirms this downtrend: the 7-period EMA is $2,422, with the price trading below it.

The MACD indicates that bearish momentum remains dominant. The histogram reads -5.67, an improvement from the previous reading of -6.43, but the gap between the DIFF line at -4.74 and the DEA line at 0.93 remains wide. Notably, the MACD histogram has contracted for two consecutive periods. If this trend continues, it could signal that bearish momentum is fading.

For RSI, the 6-period RSI is 38, the 12-period RSI is 42, and the 24-period RSI is 46, with the short-term RSI entering relatively low territory. The 6-period RSI previously fell to an oversold reading of 19 before rebounding, suggesting that extreme selling pressure has eased. In the KDJ indicator, K is 24, D is 25, and J is 23. All three lines are in low territory and beginning to flatten, leaving open the possibility of a bullish bottom crossover.

The Bollinger Bands show the price trading near the lower band at $2,402. The middle band is at $2,442 and the upper band at $2,482. Trading close to the lower band points to short-term weakness, but also suggests that the likelihood of an oversold rebound is increasing. A move back above the middle band would confirm a short-term trend reversal.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Sentiment in the Ethereum market is currently bearish, though the degree of pessimism has begun to ease at the margin. Large transfers of ETH to exchanges by whales are generally seen as a potential selling signal. Combined with continued ETF outflows, this has significantly dented market confidence in the short term. However, on-chain activity shows that the Ethereum ecosystem remains active. While the growth of layer-2 networks raises concerns about fragmentation at the settlement layer, it has also expanded the ecosystem’s user base and trading volume.

From a capital-flow perspective, short-term institutional withdrawals contrast with continued retail inflows. Binance has recorded net inflows for four consecutive weeks, indicating that although large holders are reducing their positions, small and medium-sized investors are still buying the dip. In addition, the market capitalization of RWAs in the Solana ecosystem has grown sixfold in a year to $4.3 billion. While this creates some competition for Ethereum’s market share, the overall expansion of the RWA sector also indirectly benefits Ethereum’s role as an underlying settlement asset.

Overall, Ethereum faces the dual pressures of whale selling and ETF outflows in the short term. However, several technical indicators have entered oversold territory, and rebound demand is building. Investors should pay close attention to the strength of support at the $2,400 level and whether ETF flows show signs of turning around. If the macro environment improves, Ethereum may see a technical recovery rally.

以太坊市场深度分析：短期承压明显但底部支撑逐步增强

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月十六日，以太坊报价两千四百一十五美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之一点八六。价格在亚洲时段一度下探至两千三百九十三美元的近期低点，随后在两千四百美元整数关口附近获得支撑，反弹至两千四百一十九美元附近窄幅震荡。从小时K线来看，近五个周期的波动幅度逐步收窄，成交量从五千万美元级别递减至七百万美元级别，显示抛压正在减弱但买盘同样谨慎。

本周以太坊面临的压力主要来自两方面。其一是大户向交易所转入大量以太坊，其中一笔达一万五千三百六十一枚的鲸鱼存款引发了市场对潜在抛售的担忧。其二是以太坊现货ETF在十月十五日出现六千零三十万美元的净流出，叠加此前一亿两千九百五十万美元的单日赎回，机构资金持续撤离对价格形成明显压制。不过，嘉信理财等传统金融机构开放加密交易渠道，以及银行托管业务的扩展，为以太坊提供了基础层面的支撑。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的空头排列格局。七日均线两千四百一十九美元低于二十五日均线两千四百四十三美元，更低于九十九日均线两千四百五十七美元，价格运行在所有主要均线下方，短期趋势偏弱。指数移动平均线同样确认这一下行结构，七周期EMA为两千四百二十二美元，价格在其下方运行。

MACD指标显示空头动能仍在主导市场。柱状图数值为负五点六七，虽然较前值负六点四三有所改善，但DIFF线负四点七四与DEA线零点九三之间的差距仍然较大。值得关注的是，MACD柱状图已连续两个周期收窄，若这一趋势延续，可能预示着空头力量的衰竭。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为三十八，十二周期RSI为四十二，二十四周期RSI为四十六，短周期RSI已进入相对低位区域。此前六周期RSI一度跌至十九的超卖水平，随后出现反弹，表明极端卖压已有所释放。KDJ指标中K值二十四、D值二十五、J值二十三，三线均处于低位区域且开始走平，存在形成底部金叉的可能性。

布林带显示价格运行在下轨两千四百零二美元附近，中轨为两千四百四十二美元，上轨为两千四百八十二美元。价格贴近下轨运行意味着短期处于弱势状态，但同时也暗示超跌反弹的概率在增加。若价格能重新站上中轨，将确认短期趋势的扭转。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前的情绪偏向悲观，但悲观程度已在边际上减弱。鲸鱼向交易所大额转账的行为通常被视为潜在抛售信号，叠加ETF持续流出的数据，短期内市场信心受到明显打击。然而，从链上活动来看，以太坊生态依然保持活跃，二层网络的发展虽然带来了结算层碎片化的隐忧，但也扩展了整个生态的用户基数和交易量。

从资金流向角度分析，机构资金的短期撤离与零售资金的持续流入形成了有趣的对比。币安平台连续四周录得净流入，表明尽管大户在减仓，但中小投资者仍在逢低布局。此外，Solana生态的RWA市值在一年内增长六倍至四十三亿美元，虽然对以太坊的市场份额构成一定竞争，但整体RWA赛道的扩张对以太坊作为底层结算资产的地位也构成间接利好。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临鲸鱼抛售和ETF流出的双重压力，但技术面多项指标已进入超卖区域，反弹需求在积聚。投资者应重点关注两千四百美元关口的支撑力度，以及ETF资金流向能否出现拐点。若宏观环境改善，以太坊有望迎来一波技术性修复行情。
